matches.quote: The 0.7 eV peak in PrNiO2 is assigned to Pr 5d hybridized states without independent evidence and then disregarded
Five parameters (J1–J4, J⊥) are fitted to a single dispersion... J1, J2 and J3 are expected to be strongly correlated... report the fit covariance or correlation matrix
a dispersion consistent with LSW does not establish long-range 3D order... change "support a 3D antiferromagnetic order" to "show three-dimensional spin correlations"
The PrNiO2 d_z² energy (2.96 ± 0.58 eV, Table I) is too uncertain to support "a possibly larger energy in the nickelate"; remove or qualify that statement.
quantified, for example by crossed/total ratios per peak in data versus calculation... the d_xy intensity mismatch at H = 0.4 (σ) is attributed to Pr 5d... without a test
an artefact of the elastic/phonon subtraction... show the Γ-point spectra, their decomposition and the sensitivity of J⊥ to them
Fig. 2(a) shows a sum of spectra over H = 0.4–0.475, across which the magnon disperses, which broadens it.
The magnon damping comparison does not isolate self-doping... compare with Sr-doped infinite-layer nickelates (Ref. 12, Ref. 46) or literature NdNiO2/LaNiO2 damping
The two films sit on different substrates and their strain state is not given... state whether each film is relaxed or strained
The suggestion of stripe order from the (0.2,0.2) dispersion maximum and the extra elastic intensity beyond (0.25,0.25) (p. 5) is unsupported.
J⊥ is constrained essentially by a handful of points near Γ... carry the largest error bars in Fig. 3(a)... show the Γ-point spectra, their decomposition
state which fit parameters (widths, positions and amplitudes of neighbouring peaks, the RE-peak position and weight, the continuum shape) are free, fixed or shared across Q
The parameters behind the single-ion calculations in Fig. 4(g–l) are not given: crystal-field values... spin–orbit coupling, exchange field, core-hole lifetime and broadening.
The statement on p. 5 that the magnon/J⊥ result gives "a proof of the fully occurred topotactic reduction … and absence of interstitial oxygen atoms" does not follow
Δ = 8.00 eV was "chosen... providing reasonable results"... U = 3.2 eV... give effective one-band U values rather than the on-site multiplet Hubbard U

notes: C8 and C18 are rated 'partly' because the review raises the shifting-component-weight mechanism and peak-tracking issues primarily for the PrNiO2 d_xy peak (P15) and the low-q magnon decomposition near Gamma (P3), rather than the full magnon dispersion or the CaCuO2 d_xy mode in Fig. 5c. C2 and C3 are rated 'partly' because the review questions completeness of oxygen reduction, single-phase purity, and the Pr 5d assignment of the 0.7 eV feature (P19, P20, P21, P23) without specifically framing 'chemically undoped' as inappropriate or citing the impurity-diffraction correlation.
